[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] flew a [[Color/Legends|purple and dark gray]] '''Eta-2 ''Actis''-class interceptor''' during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]].

==History==
[[File:MaceWinduJSF-Hasbro.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Mace flying the interceptor over Coruscant]]
Mace Windu flew this starfighter through [[Coruscant/Legends|the city]] during the Battle of Coruscant. It was destroyed when it flew into a swarm of [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]]. Nonetheless, Windu managed to eject from the cockpit safely.
